name: @aegisvpn/desktop
description: AegisVPN desktop client for Windows, macOS and Linux. Electron shell orchestrating the official WireGuard implementations (wireguard-nt / wg-quick); the renderer is an unprivileged React UI behind a strict IPC contract.
author: AegisVPN <ops@aegisvpn.example>

scripts.dev: npm run build:main && concurrently -k -s first "vite" "wait-on tcp:127.0.0.1:5183 && VITE_DEV_SERVER_URL=http://localhost:5183 electron ."
